nodes.name: COMPLETE SYSTEMS → Data Scraping + Processing Webhook

parameters.content:
WHAT IT DOES: 

Transforms raw scraped or imported business records into a clean, standardized, analysis-ready dataset.
 

HOW IT DOES IT: 

Accepts records through a webhook or manual demo, standardizes names, URLs, emails, and employee counts, removes duplicates, rejects invalid records with clear reasons, and returns a structured processing summary.


WHY PAY FOR IT: 

It eliminates repetitive manual data cleanup, improves CRM and outreach data quality, prevents teams from wasting time on duplicates or invalid contacts, and creates a reusable processing layer for lead generation, research, reporting, and automation systems.

## SETUP + PURPOSE

Accepts scraped records or sample HTML-derived data, cleans and deduplicates records, validates URLs and emails, and produces an analysis-ready dataset.
